# TRANSCRIPTION FACTOR 

## Prep Data 
```{r}
# prepare counts
RNA_seq_counts_tf <- AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts_clean %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  left_join(RNA_manifest[, c("INVENTORY.CODE", "Timepoint")], by = "INVENTORY.CODE") %>%
  dplyr::select(INVENTORY.CODE, PID, Timepoint, everything())

TF_analysis_data <- RNA_seq_counts_tf %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(TF_analysis_data) <- TF_analysis_data$INVENTORY.CODE

# split metadata and counts
metadata_tf <- TF_analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::select(1:3)

count_matrix_tf <- TF_analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-(1:3))

# transpose counts: genes as rows, samples as columns
count_matrix_tf <- t(count_matrix_tf)
colnames(count_matrix_tf) <- rownames(TF_analysis_data)


# build regulon list
data(dorothea_hs, package = "dorothea")

reg_list <- dorothea_hs %>%
  filter(confidence %in% c("A", "B", "C")) %>%
  dorothea::df2regulon()

# global normalization
dge_tf <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = round(count_matrix_tf))

keep_tf <- edgeR::filterByExpr(dge_tf,
  group = metadata_tf$Timepoint,
  min.count = 3)

dge_tf <- dge_tf[keep_tf, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_tf <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge_tf)

voom_tf <- limma::voom(dge_tf, plot = FALSE)

# match gene symbols to regulon naming
rownames(voom_tf$E) <- toupper(rownames(voom_tf$E))
voom_tf$E <- voom_tf$E[!duplicated(rownames(voom_tf$E)), , drop = FALSE]

# infer TF activity globally
tf_activity_mat <- viper::viper(
  voom_tf$E,
  reg_list,
  minsize = 25,
  verbose = FALSE)

```

## Data for analysis 
```{r}
# convert to sample x TF dataframe
tf_activity_df <- tf_activity_mat %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("INVENTORY.CODE") %>%
  left_join(
    metadata_tf %>% dplyr::select(INVENTORY.CODE, PID, Timepoint),
    by = "INVENTORY.CODE")

dim(tf_activity_df)

write.csv(tf_activity_df, "Data/Transcription Factor Data/Data Files/TF_activity_All_n890.csv")


tf_activity_df_ED6M <- tf_activity_df %>%
  filter(INVENTORY.CODE %in% ICs_490_ED6M)

write.csv(tf_activity_df_ED6M, "Data/Transcription Factor Data/Analysis Data/TF_activity_ED6M_analysis.csv")

tf_activity_df_ED2WK6M <- tf_activity_df %>%
  filter(INVENTORY.CODE %in% ICs_120_ED2WK6M)

write.csv(tf_activity_df_ED2WK6M, "Data/Transcription Factor Data/Analysis Data/TF_activity_ED2WK6M_analysis.csv")
```
